topic: Build an Agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio
course_description: A practice-oriented path aligned to the Microsoft Applied Skills assessment APL-6006, "Build an agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio". Built from the assessment's own preparation modules on Microsoft Learn, it walks through creating and publishing an agent, designing topic-based conversations, grounding the agent with knowledge and generative AI, and adding a workflow tool.
audience: App makers and business users with basic familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio who want to build a custom agent end to end, including anyone preparing for the APL-6006 Applied Skills assessment
intended_learning_outcome: Build, configure, and publish a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent that uses topics for guided conversations, is grounded with knowledge and generative AI, and calls a workflow tool
